findings.detail: B02 duplicate keys are explained by same issuers appearing in separate 2025 and 2024 SOI blocks; the 2024 Corza row should not create a duplicate 2025 position key.

rationale: The bundle reports 5 duplicate position keys for the 2025-12-31 CIK-quarter, with Corza Medical Srl as an example. Raw source shows a 2025 Corza row with fair value 19,950 in the current SOI block and a separate Corza row with fair value 17,385 in the later comparative/prior-period SOI block; filing totals also separate 2025 total investments of 2,177,821 from 2024 total investments of 984,954. The duplicate is therefore a real extraction/classification defect caused by comparative-period leakage rather than two distinct 2025 positions.
